# DevoraX — AI-Powered Mobile & Web Development Agency
# https://thedevorax.tech

## About
DevoraX is an AI-powered software development agency that builds high-performance mobile apps,
Next.js web platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations. We partner with founders and
CTOs worldwide to ship production-grade software fast.

## Services
- Mobile App Development (React Native, Flutter)
- AI-Powered Web Development (Next.js, Python)
- Cloud & DevOps (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes)
- UI/UX Design Systems
- E-Commerce Solutions
- Data & Analytics
